summary: Implementation plan for redesigning the Fitness & Freshness (PMC) chart markers in FitnessHealthView.tsx: replacing routine TSS/double-day dots with true physiological and race milestones (eFTP breakthroughs, Official Races & Running PRs, and Power Curve / Benchmark Segment PRs), restricting CTL curve dots to A-Races and eFTP breakthroughs, and adding color-coded X-axis milestone badges with hover tooltip details and an interactive legend.
